note: Ground-floor questions room: the question words. They have no gender, so no left/right rule (divider null). Grouped scene on a rug with a reading chair, a counting table and a hat stand. The white door on the left wall goes back to the articles room; the white door at the back right leads to the pronouns hall. Zoom: the little pale pupil's desk in the front right corner.
